_comment: Overrides applied on top of params/default.json. Selecting a profile
re-tunes every fit and DFM limit at once, so the same nominal model can
be printed for test and moulded for production without re-modelling.
Clearance values are starting points: confirm each with a printed or
moulded fit-test coupon before committing to tooling.

fdm_prototype.description: Desktop FDM, 0.4 mm nozzle. V1 prototype process.
notes: Wall is a multiple of 0.4 mm extrusion width so perimeters come out whole.
Spills are the main ingress risk for a scale used at feeding time:
layer lines make printed surfaces hard to clean; keep spill paths out of the case.

sla_verification.description: Resin, for fit and form verification before tooling.
notes: Tighter fits than FDM. Dimensional and form check only, not for
user trials: resin is brittle and not food-safe.
Uniform wall is critical: thickness variation causes sink and warp.
PP shrinks roughly 1.3-2.0%; the toolmaker applies shrinkage, the CAD
model stays at nominal part size.
Every mould-parallel face needs draft or the part drags on ejection.
